issues.description: Lila's Button Set (M1_button_set) hero shows a generic ten-frame with 5 black dots labelled 'Ten Frame', not 'Per-pair set of 50 small printed button cards in 5 colours' as the description states. Teachers cannot preview the actual button cards used in Lessons 1, 3, and 4.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run the manipulative composer for M1_button_set to render an actual sheet of small button-card tokens (5 colours x 10) instead of a placeholder ten-frame.

issues.description: Estimation Button Jar (M2_estimation_jar) hero shows a generic 5-dot ten-frame with caption 'Ten Frame', but the description says 'Clear jar with 35-50 buttons' — the central artifact for the Lesson 1 estimation hook. The actual jar/buttons are not rendered.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run the manipulative composer for M2_estimation_jar to draw an actual clear jar containing 35-50 small button shapes (possibly with the jar label as a separate decal).

issues.description: Base-Ten Rods (M3_base_ten_rods) hero shows a 5-dot ten-frame, but description states 'Per-child set: 5 ten-rods + 20 single ones'. The actual base-ten rod cards used in Lessons 2 and 3 decomposition work are not visible.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run the manipulative composer for M3_base_ten_rods to draw 5 ten-rod strips plus 20 unit cubes (or one labelled sample of each), not a generic ten-frame.

issues.description: M6_share_plates description says 'Set of 4 paper plates per group of 4' but the hero shows a 3x3 array of black dots labelled 'Array — 3 × 3'. No paper plates are rendered.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run the manipulative composer for M6_share_plates to draw actual paper plate circles instead of an unrelated dot array.

issues.description: M7_number_word_cards is described as a 'Per-pair set of 30 cards: 10 numerals + 10 number-words + 10 representations,' but the hero shows a 4x5 black-dot array labelled 'Array — 4 × 5'. No numerals, words, or representations are visible.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run the manipulative composer for M7_number_word_cards to render a sample of the three card types (numeral, word, representation) side-by-side instead of a dot array.

issues.description: Lila's Big Button Jar worksheet preview hero shows only a blank lined writing area with caption 'Show a real-life problem.' (labelled 'Real-Life Box'). The button-jar estimation artwork that should be the worksheet hero is not rendered — only an empty rectangle.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run the worksheet composer for Ws01 hero so the slide shows the actual button-jar estimation image (jars with varying button counts) rather than an empty lined rectangle.

issues.description: Number Friends Five Ways worksheet preview hero shows a blank lined area labelled 'Ws02 P3 Five Ways Boxes' with caption 'Show your work below.' The five-form representation grid (numeral / word / ten-frame / base-ten / tally) that is the heart of the worksheet is not rendered.
issues.suggested_fix: Re-run the worksheet composer for Ws02 P3 so the hero shows the actual 'five ways' grid with sample number 32 displayed in numeral, word, ten-frame, base-ten, and tally form.

issues.description: Lesson 2 Consolidation Exit text ends mid-sentence: 'Exit: Teacher writes a number (e.g.' with the example clause cut off. The teacher script is incomplete on the slide.
issues.suggested_fix: Edit the lesson 2 consolidation_exit field to complete the sentence with a concrete example (e.g., '...e.g., 27. Children write it three ways.') so the slide shows the full prompt.

issues.description: Lesson 3 Consolidation discussion ends 'Can you tell me ONE thing in your everyday life that you could decompose? (e.g.' — also truncated mid-example. The Exit prompt below it cuts off teacher guidance.
issues.suggested_fix: Complete the example after '(e.g.' in the lesson 3 discussion bullet or remove the trailing '(e.g.' so the bullet ends cleanly without dangling punctuation.

issues.description: Lesson 5 Action and consolidation_exit both contain ellipses for truncated text: 'Round 4:…' and '...line up at the…'. Whole-group recap mini-station list also ends with '…'. Several teacher prompts are unfinished on the slide.
issues.suggested_fix: Audit the Lesson 5 lesson JSON for any field ending in '…' or 'e.g.' and complete or shorten so the slide layout displays complete sentences.

issues.description: Summative Rubric Expectation column shows every row truncated with '…' (B1.1, B1.2, B1.3, B1.4, B1.5, B1.6, B1.7) and most Level 1-4 descriptor cells also end with '…'. Teachers cannot read the full curriculum text or achievement-level criteria.
issues.suggested_fix: Widen the Expectation column and shrink cell font in the summative rubric so the full B1.1-B1.8 expectations and all four achievement-level descriptors fit without ellipsis.

summary: Seven blocking missing-asset issues: five manipulative slides (button set, estimation jar, base-ten rods, sharing plates, number-word cards) render as generic ten-frames or dot arrays instead of the asset described, and two worksheet hero previews (Ws01, Ws02) are blank lined rectangles. Lila/Otto/Scoot puppets are kawaii-styled and recognizable. Manipulative and worksheet composer re-runs needed.
